title: Positive electrode for secondary battery and secondary battery including the same
abstract: The present invention provides a positive electrode for a secondary battery and a secondary battery including the positive electrode. The positive electrode comprises a positive electrode active material layer containing a positive electrode active material, a conductive material and a dispersant, wherein the conductive material comprises bundled carbon nanotubes, and the units of the bundled carbon nanotubes have an average strand diameter of 15 nm or less, and The positive electrode active material layer has a packing density of 3.0 g/cc or more, and the positive electrode active material layer has an average pore size of 0.1 μm to 0.5 μm at the packing density when the pore size distribution is measured by a mercury intrusion method, whereby Can exhibit excellent electrolyte wetting properties. As a result, when the positive electrode is applied to a battery, the wetting time of the positive electrode is shortened, and the area of the positive electrode unfilled with electrolyte is reduced, resulting in improved battery performance.
